description: This file contains functions for sending repository ratings and error messages to GitHub issues within a Probot app, specifically related to bug localization and ranking files likely to contain bugs.

methods.name: sendRatings
methods.description: Sends ranked file information to a GitHub issue comment, or posts an error message if no ratings are available.

methods.name: replyWithError
methods.description: Posts an error message as a comment on a GitHub issue.
